notes.title: UPDATE 2 – Three Player Mode added and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/47fbf30adb55fe150f189181d02a020577e0d3d8.gif[/img]
Ever since RAGING JUSTICE launched back in May, we’ve received a wealth of feedback from both old school arcade gamers and newcomers alike about everything you love and want to love about the game.

We’ve had all sorts of constructive criticism that has been passed on to the developers at MakinGames, and together we’ve worked tirelessly to bring you a wealth of improvements that we really think you’ll get a kick out of!

As of today, we’re pleased to confirm that Steam players can now take to the mean streets of RAGING JUSTICE as Rick, Nikki and Ashley in full three player co-op mode! You can even use a combination of controllers and keyboard to play as you wish!

As well as the new three player mode, we’ve also added an easier difficulty level, the ability for multiple players to play as the same character and various other improvements in response to your feedback. See below for the full list of changes…

•	3 player local co-op in all modes.
•	Difficulty adjustments to boss fights
•	Added 'colour mask' to the player-characters to allow people to play as the same character.
•	Added a new ‘Casual’ difficulty mode. Casual mode is the same difficulty as Wimp but with unlimited credits. No achievements can be unlocked on this difficulty.
•	Added ability to remap controllers.
•	Players no longer drop weapons when hit.
•	Added new cheat to the cheat menu – Unbreakable Weapons.
•	Added ability to dash with weapons.
•	Added ability to change screen resolutions
•	Minor bug fixes and improvements.

These changes are just the beginning too! While you read this, MakinGames is already busy working on Update 3, with even more new features and adjustments that we’re certain you’ll enjoy. In the meantime, we’d love to hear what you think of today’s update. So please let us know here on Steam, on [url=https://www.facebook.com/RagingJustice/]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/RAGING_JUSTICE]Twitter[/url] so we can keep making RAGING JUSTICE the best beat-em-up it can be.

Oh and, one more thing… If you’re looking for a friend to join you in the new three player mode then now is the time to tell them about RAGING JUSTICE as the Steam version is 40% off until August 17th!

notes.title: UPDATE 1: Stun Meter & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi all! You may have noticed a small update to RAGING JUSTICE today. This update is intended for both PC and Mac players and includes a handful of fixes to problems highlighted by the community.

As always, if you have any feedback for RAGING JUSTICE, please make sure to let us know in the discussion forums.

IMPROVEMENTS IN PATCH 1:

•	Added Stun Power bars under enemy health bars, so you can better judge the level of stun on each enemy.
•	Fixed a bug whereby it was possible to end a stage before posting to the leaderboard.
•	Made some improvements to the analogue dead zones when using DualShock 4 controllers.
•	Small change localisation corrections.
•	Finally, you may noticed that the old Team17 logo at the start of the game has been updated to our shiny brand new version!

notes.title: RAGING JUSTICE – High Score Contest
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/26f39688eca8bf34d33edf83c70b341506b3196e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/baf73487f3ad566d247bae1326921d7538068b8a.jpg[/img][/url]

RAGING JUSTICE – a brand new beat-em-up by the ex-Rare team at MakinGames – released last week on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC and Mac, and we’ve been hearing great things from fans of the genre since! Thank you to everyone who believed in the vision to revive a classic arcade style of game with a few modern gameplay twists!

Arcade games, of course, were all about the high score board. And in that spirit, we’d like to launch the first ever RAGING JUSTICE community high score contest! If you own a copy of the game on any of the above formats then you have everything you need to take part – and you could win a big bundle of prizes including… 

A RAGING JUSTICE branded arcade cabinet for the Nintendo Switch console, a set of RAGING JUSTICE pin badges, RAGING JUSTICE beer mats, a RAGING JUSTICE t-shirt and a RAGING JUSTICE download code to share with a friend!

To be in with a chance of winning, all you have to do is the following:

1. Play RAGING JUSTICE’s Brawl Mode on the Bar Broom Brawl stage and set your own high score.
2. Take a screenshot or photo of your score and share to Twitter with the hashtags #RAGINGJUSTICE and #SCOREOFJUSTICE
3. That’s it! Whoever has set the top score by Friday May 25th will receive the goodie bag of prizes!

Do you have what it takes to be the baddest dude in RAGING JUSTICE? Check out the full terms and conditions over on the [url=https://www.team17.com/raging-justice-high-score-contest/raging-justice/]Team17 website![/url]

notes.title: New character and release date!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/8d0b23cc83f013508b37e864b3cde860fcc9ccbf.gif[/img]
Hi everyone!

Today we’re very excited to reveal [b]a third playable character[/b] for RAGING JUSTICE; [b]Ashley King[/b]! A street-smart kid used to fending for themself, Ashley’s guaranteed to deliver a backpack full of whoop-ass should you decide to serve some justice with their help!
[list][*]NAME: [b]Ashley King[/b]
[*]HEIGHT: 5’5”
[*]AGE: 15
[*]INFO: Ash’s inner-city upbringing was blighted by the fear of gang violence. Fast and lethal, Ash learned to fight on the streets, using movies as inspiration for an arsenal of lethal moves including a signature Crane Kick finisher.[/list]
Check out the brand new trailer below to see some of their kick-ass moves in action, and let us know what you think. Also, with three characters now available, [b]which one are you picking first? [/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3_1mFwMCZnc
More than just revealing the third playable character, we’re happy to confirm that [b]RAGING JUSTICE will be coming[/b] to a Steam account near you on [b]8th May 2018[/b] (alongside PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch)!

Will you be serving some raging justice on day one? Be sure to follow and Wishlist the game on Steam to ensure you don’t miss a beat, and that you’re ready to take to the streets in just over a month. If you’d like additional glimpses into the game alongside some inspirational Quotes of Rage between now and launch, be sure to follow RAGING JUSTICE on [url=https://twitter.com/Raging_Justice]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/RagingJustice/]Facebook[/url] as well, and join the conversation over on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/384200/discussions/]the community hub[/url], or [url=http://discord.gg/team17]our Discord server[/url].
